body:
## Answers to Open Questions

### 1. Mesh edge chains vs B-rep edges

Manual selection picks mesh edge chains (`FeatureSel::Chain`), not B-rep edges.

- `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step.rs` tessellates STEP solids (`truck_stepio`) into `Triangle` facets (`CHORD_CAP = 0.0025 mm`) at import time.
- `crates/app/src/schema.rs` stores `Facets` on the model entity and keeps no B-rep topology.
- `crates/geometry/src/geometry/feature.rs`, `SetOperationGeometry` (`crates/app/src/commands/operation/geometry.rs`), `PickKinds::EDGES` (`crates/app/src/pick/feature_pick.rs`), `drive_chains` (`crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs`), and `mcp::pick` (`crates/app/src/mcp/pick.rs`) already use `FeatureSel::Chain(ChainId)`.
- Included edges go into `SrcRef::Selection` on `OpParams::Deburr`. Excluded edges go into a new `exclude_edges: Vec<GeoSel>` field (default empty).
- Auto-detection reads `facets` directly when `min_edge_angle_deg` is less than `CREASE_DEG` (`40.0` deg in `crates/geometry/src/geometry/feature.rs`).

### 2. Width definition: chamfer width `w` vs setback `s`

Use chamfer width `w` (the chord between the two cut borders, `w = 2 * s * sin(theta / 2)`) as the single width parameter for all tools. Use depth `d = s * cos(theta / 2)` for Constant Depth mode.

- `w` gives one ball limit across all wedge angles `theta`: `R >= w / 2` (`D >= w`).
- Public CAD/CAM docs and edge-measure summaries from ISO 13715 (Aurich et al., *CIRP Annals* 58(2), 2009) keep bevel width constant across acute and obtuse edges. Setback `s` changes the bevel width when `theta` changes.
- Today, `crates/motion/src/finishing3d/deburr.rs` defines `width` as the horizontal leg `s` (`drop = width / tan(half-angle)`). `deburr_at_the_wall_corner_is_chamfer_byte_for_byte` (`crates/motion/tests/deburr.rs`) pins `Deburr { width: 2.0, tip_angle_deg: 90.0 }` to `Chamfer2D { width: 2.0, angle_deg: 45.0 }`.
- Changing `Deburr.width` to chord `w` needs a `PROJECT_VERSION` step (`61` -> `62` in `crates/app/src/project/file.rs`). That step multiplies old 3D `Deburr.width` values by `sqrt(2)` (the 90-degree corner ratio). `Chamfer2D.width` keeps its 2D horizontal leg definition.

### 3. Multi-axis mode: inside `Deburr` vs separate operation

Add a separate operation `OpType::MultiAxisDeburr` in `Section::MultiAxis`. Share the edge-break solver in `crates/motion/`.

- `RECOMMENDED.md` sets the "two-kinds-not-one" rule. That rule separates 3-axis operations from multi-axis operations.
- `OpParams::Deburr` belongs to `Section::Mill3D` (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`). Its `tilt()` returns `None` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs`). The UI shows it in `mill2d_more_page.rs`.
- Multi-axis operations live in `Section::MultiAxis` (`multiaxis_page.rs`). They pass 4-axis and 5-axis machine checks. They share `curve_walk`, `AxisControl`, `escape_axis`, and `shank_hits_at` in `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/`.
- Append `OpType::MultiAxisDeburr` at the end of `KindInfo::ALL` after ordinal `43` (`SinkerSideBurn` in `crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`). Saved operation ordinals then never shift (`crates/app/tests/ribbon.rs`).

### 4. Default minimum edge angle and default width

Use a default minimum edge angle of `40.0 deg` (`acos(n1.dot(n2)) >= 40.0 deg`) and a default width of `0.5 mm`.

- `seed_deburr` (`crates/app/src/operation/kinds.rs`) already sets `width: 0.5`. Keeping `0.5 mm` preserves the current default.
- `CREASE_DEG = 40.0` (`crates/geometry/src/geometry/feature.rs`) controls clickable wireframe chains. Using `40.0 deg` keeps auto-detected edges aligned with `Chain` picks. It also stops curved mesh facets from triggering false creases (`crates/app/src/operation/fidelity_law.rs`). Users can lower the limit when they want shallow bevels.

---

## Design Proposal (Smallest Useful First Slice First)

Build the work in seven small slices. Each slice with new user settings must include a command, project file fields (`crates/app/src/project/file.rs`), MCP `ParamsDto` fields (`crates/app/src/mcp/`), and UI controls (`crates/ui/`).

1. **First useful slice — Edge selection, exclusion, angle filter, and hole filter.** Users control which edges `Deburr` cuts with the existing cone tool. Remove `OpType::Deburr` from `!selection_drives_region` (`crates/app/src/operation/material_region.rs`) so `SrcRef::Selection` (`FeatureSel::Chain`) drives it. Add `exclude_edges: Vec<GeoSel>`, `min_edge_angle_deg: f64` (default `40.0`), and circular hole filters built on `drilling::recognize` and `recognize_cross` (`crates/motion/src/drilling/recognize.rs`).
2. **Unreachable edge policy.** Add a user parameter (`SkipWithNote` default vs `Refuse`) for steep or blocked edge parts. Keep skip-with-note as the default. Fail closed by name when the user sets `Refuse`.
3. **Break geometry and width unification.** Migrate `Deburr.width` to chord `w` (`PROJECT_VERSION` `61` -> `62`, `sqrt(2)` scale on legacy files). Add `ConstantWidth` vs `ConstantDepth` sizing, `Chamfer` vs `Round` profiles, and multi-pass step parameters. Cones support multi-pass chamfers and refuse `Round` by name until ball-tipped tools land.
4. **3D `EdgeBreak` records and `#529`-bounded sim credit.** `crates/cl/src/cl/edge_break.rs` models only a flat vertical-axis cone (`z_edge - depth + slope * d`). Extend `EdgeBreak`, `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/edge_break.rs`, and `crates/app/src/stock_sim_breaks.rs` for 3D bisector chamfers, concave ball sweeps (`R >= w / 2`), and rounded profiles. Keep the `#529` depth and width upper bounds strict.
5. **3-axis Ball mill (`ToolKind::BallNose`) deburr.** Compute ball centers on the outward bisector `C = E + h * b` (Abele et al. 2018; Schutzer et al. 2019; Wei et al. 2021). Add a flute contact position setting and a vertical-edge toggle. Safety note: do not switch `Deburr` to `Mode::Envelope` (`crates/sim/src/verify/finish.rs`), because `envelope_scan` judges whole-part `Scallop`, rest, and `cuts_no_material` on uncut faces. Verify ball, `NeckBands` (`crates/tools/src/neck.rs`), shank, and holder clearance against non-break solid faces instead.
6. **3-axis Lollipop undercut deburr.** Coordinate with #896 (`ToolKind::Lollipop` / spun profile physics) and #1444 (no-retract-under-material link safety). Reach steep, vertical, and under-overhang edges with upper-hemisphere contact and neck clearance checks.
7. **`MultiAxisDeburr` (4-axis and 5-axis).** Add `OpType::MultiAxisDeburr` in `Section::MultiAxis` with `axis_mode` (4-axis or 5-axis), `lead_deg`, `lag_deg`, and `max_tilt_deg`. Reuse the bisector contact math with `curve_walk`, `AxisControl`, `escape_axis`, and `shank_hits_at` (`crates/motion/src/multiaxis/`) to tilt around holder obstacles (Gosselin 2021).

---

## Concrete Sub-Issues

1. **3D Deburr: manual edge selection and exclusion, min edge angle, and hole filter**
   - Adds `SrcRef::Selection` edge chains, `exclude_edges`, `min_edge_angle_deg` (default `40.0`), and a hole diameter filter to `Deburr`, with command, project, MCP, and UI support.
   - Done means: user includes or excludes `FeatureSel::Chain` edges, filters creases below `min_edge_angle_deg`, and skips circular holes inside a diameter range in both UI and MCP, pinned by motion and app tests.
   - Proposed: `P4`, `effort:high`, `area:3d`

2. **3D Deburr: configurable policy for unreachable edge segments (skip with note or refuse)**
   - Adds an unreachable-edge setting (`SkipWithNote` default vs `Refuse`) across `DeburrParams`, `OpParams::Deburr`, project files, MCP, and UI.
   - Done means: `SkipWithNote` skips unreachable edge segments with a named note, `Refuse` rejects the operation by name when any segment fails reach, and UI and MCP control both modes.
   - Proposed: `P4`, `effort:high`, `area:3d`

3. **3D Deburr: chamfer width `w`, Constant Depth mode, and multi-pass break profiles**
   - Switches `Deburr.width` to chord `w` (migrating v61 to v62), adds `ConstantWidth` and `ConstantDepth` modes, adds multi-pass step parameters, and adds `Chamfer` and `Round` profile choice.
   - Done means: v61 `Deburr` projects migrate cleanly by `sqrt(2)`, Constant Width and Constant Depth cones cut exact bevels, multi-pass cone chamfers verify clean, and `Round` refuses on sharp cones by name.
   - Proposed: `P4`, `effort:high`, `area:3d`

4. **Sim: extend `EdgeBreak` records and bounded credit for 3D bisector, ball, and rounded edge breaks**
   - Extends `EdgeBreak` and `credit_breaks` from vertical cone slopes to 3D bisector chamfers, concave ball sweeps, and rounded multi-pass profiles while keeping #529 upper bounds strict.
   - Done means: valid 3D bisector, ball, and rounded breaks pass verify without false gouges, inflated or corrupted `EdgeBreak` records still drop by name, and real gouges outside the break still convict.
   - Proposed: `P4`, `effort:max`, `area:sim`, `area:3d`

5. **3D Deburr: 3-axis BallNose support with bisector contact, contact offset, and collision check**
   - Permits `ToolKind::BallNose` in `OpType::Deburr` using `C = E + h * b`, adds a flute contact offset and vertical-edge toggle, and checks ball, neck, shank, and holder clearance without whole-part `Scallop` rest errors.
   - Done means: a `BallNose` cutter deburs oblique and top edges when `R >= w / 2`, undersized cutters refuse by name, shank and holder hits obey the unreachable policy, and paths verify clean via `EdgeBreak`.
   - Proposed: `P4`, `effort:max`, `area:3d`, `area:sim`

6. **3D Deburr: 3-axis Lollipop undercut support for steep, vertical, and overhang edges**
   - Enables `ToolKind::Lollipop` in `OpType::Deburr` (coordinated with #896 cutter profile physics and #1444 undercut retract rules) to cut steep, vertical, and under-overhang edges safely.
   - Done means: a lollipop tool deburs vertical and under-overhang edges with upper-hemisphere contact and neck clearance, under-stock Z retracts refuse per #1444 rules, and stock sim verifies clean.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:max`, `area:3d`, `area:sim`

7. **MultiAxisDeburr: 4-axis and 5-axis edge-break operation with holder collision tilt**
   - Adds `OpType::MultiAxisDeburr` in `Section::MultiAxis` combining bisector deburr geometry with `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/` collision-avoidance tilt for 4-axis and 5-axis machines.
   - Done means: `MultiAxisDeburr` appends at the tail of `KindInfo::ALL`, exposes 4-axis/5-axis mode, `lead_deg`, `lag_deg`, and `max_tilt_deg` in UI and MCP, tilts around holder obstacles, and posts and verifies clean.
   - Proposed: `P6`, `effort:max`, `area:multiaxis`, `area:sim`

Filed the sub-issues for this umbrella:

1. #1888 — 3D Deburr: manual edge selection and exclusion, min edge angle, and hole filter (`P4`, `effort:high`, `area:3d`)
2. #1889 — 3D Deburr: configurable policy for unreachable edge segments (skip with note or refuse) (`P4`, `effort:high`, `area:3d`)
3. #1890 — 3D Deburr: chamfer width w, Constant Depth mode, and multi-pass break profiles (`P4`, `effort:high`, `area:3d`)
4. #1891 — Sim: extend EdgeBreak records and bounded credit for 3D bisector, ball, and rounded edge breaks (`P4`, `effort:max`, `area:sim`, `area:3d`)
5. #1892 — 3D Deburr: 3-axis BallNose support with bisector contact, contact offset, and collision check (`P4`, `effort:max`, `area:3d`, `area:sim`)
6. #1893 — 3D Deburr: 3-axis Lollipop undercut support for steep, vertical, and overhang edges (`P6`, `effort:max`, `area:3d`, `area:sim`)
7. #1894 — MultiAxisDeburr: 4-axis and 5-axis edge-break operation with holder collision tilt (`P6`, `effort:max`, `area:multiaxis`, `area:sim`)

This issue stays open for maintainer review.
